# What you can put in a zone

The 70 helpers, what each is for, and a working example of each.

**The example is the contract.** It is a real spec, and check-render draws every
one of them at four widths on every run, so it cannot describe a field that does
not exist or miss one that does. Copy its shape and change the content.

**Numbering is `question: true` and nothing else.** Mark a question with it, as
the examples below do, and the engine counts every marked question in reading
order. Never write a number or a `startAt` yourself: a hand-numbered sheet is
the failure the counting was built to end.

**Smallest usable** is the helper's own answer for the example shown, and it moves
with the content: a four-column table needs more width than a two-column one. The
engine refuses a zone smaller than this rather than squashing what goes in it, so
a refusal is a layout to change and never a helper to force.

If a lesson needs something no helper here can express, say so in `notes` rather
than bending the nearest one to fit. That is how the next helper gets built.

The one place a shown example differs from the tested one: a photograph is
written as `imagePath`, a filename. The build reads that file and carries the
picture inside the sheet, so the sheet still shows it after being moved or
emailed. Never write `imageHref` yourself.

## Text and questions

#### `section-label`

The mode-of-work heading a block sits under: Fluency, Practise, Apply. Marks the kind of thinking, never the topic. Put it at the top of a stack.

Smallest usable: **25mm wide x 9mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "section-label",
  "text": "Fluency"
}
```

#### `instruction`

A quiet child-facing direction that needs no question number or answer space.

Smallest usable: **45mm wide x 6mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "instruction",
  "text": "Use the place value chart to help you."
}
```

#### `questions`

One-line read-off questions with a short answer space on that line; use written-answers when the prompt itself will wrap.

Smallest usable: **60mm wide x 27mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "questions",
  "question": true,
  "text": "Answer these using the chart.",
  "items": [
    "How many children chose football?",
    "Which material let the most water through?"
  ]
}
```

#### `written-answers`

A question answered in the child's own words, with ruled lines under it.

Smallest usable: **70mm wide x 41mm tall**. Spare height: takes spare height first (it is writing space).

```json
{
  "helper": "written-answers",
  "question": true,
  "text": "Answer in full sentences.",
  "items": [
    {
      "text": "Explain how you know the answer is a multiple of four.",
      "lines": 3
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `source-text`

A passage, account or extract the child reads and works from.

Smallest usable: **70mm wide x 20mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "source-text",
  "heading": "From the school log book",
  "paragraphs": [
    "Attendance is poor this week. Many of the older boys are away at the harvest."
  ],
  "attribution": "Log book, October 1885"
}
```

## Tables

#### `data-table`

Values HANDED to the child to read from: a price list, a timetable, a set of results. Nobody writes in it.

Smallest usable: **70mm wide x 25mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "data-table",
  "caption": "What we know already",
  "columns": [
    "Material",
    "Waterproof?"
  ],
  "rows": [
    [
      "Glass",
      "yes"
    ],
    [
      "Cardboard",
      "no"
    ]
  ],
  "compact": true,
  "compactCaption": true,
  "note": "Results from our class test."
}
```

#### `recording-table`

A table the CHILD completes: any cells may be supplied and the remaining cells stay tall and blank for writing.

Smallest usable: **90mm wide x 57mm tall**. Spare height: takes spare height first (it is writing space).

```json
{
  "helper": "recording-table",
  "caption": "Test three more materials",
  "columns": [
    "Material",
    "What happened",
    "Why"
  ],
  "rows": [
    [
      "Foil",
      null,
      "It did not absorb water"
    ],
    [
      "Cling film",
      null,
      null
    ],
    [
      "Your choice",
      null,
      null
    ]
  ]
}
```

## Charts and diagrams

#### `bar-chart`

A bar chart to read off. Each bar needs room for its label underneath, so more categories need more width.

Smallest usable: **80mm wide x 60mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "bar-chart",
  "title": "Our favourite sports",
  "categories": [
    "Football",
    "Swimming",
    "Tennis"
  ],
  "values": [
    12,
    8,
    6
  ],
  "yMax": 14,
  "yInterval": 2
}
```

#### `line-graph`

A titled time-series line graph with numbered axes.

Smallest usable: **80mm wide x 55mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "line-graph",
  "title": "Temperature through the day",
  "points": [
    {
      "x": 0,
      "y": 4
    },
    {
      "x": 6,
      "y": 11
    },
    {
      "x": 12,
      "y": 17
    }
  ],
  "xLabel": "Hours",
  "yLabel": "Degrees",
  "xMax": 12,
  "yMax": 20,
  "xStep": 3,
  "yStep": 5
}
```

#### `pictogram`

A row-of-symbols pictogram with a key, where one symbol stands for several.

Smallest usable: **90mm wide x 63mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "pictogram",
  "title": "Books read this term",
  "categories": [
    "Blue",
    "Red",
    "Green"
  ],
  "values": [
    8,
    6,
    4
  ],
  "key": {
    "per": 2
  }
}
```

#### `tally-chart`

A tally table: bundles of five drawn as marks rather than the number written out.

Smallest usable: **91mm wide x 53mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json

  "helper": "tally-chart",
  "title": "How we travel to school",
  "headers": [
    "Way to travel",
    "Tally",
    "Total"
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "label": "Walk",
      "tally": 12
    },
    {
      "label": "Car",
      "tally": 7
    },
    {
      "label": "Bus",
      "tally": 4
    }
  ],
  "showTotals": true
}
```

#### `venn`

Sorting into two overlapping properties. Blank is the frame the child fills; placed is the worked example. Not maths-only.

Smallest usable: **108mm wide x 58mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "venn",
  "label1": "waterproof",
  "label2": "can be recycled",
  "items": [
    {
      "region": "leftOnly",
      "label": "Wax"
    }
  ],
  "showRegionHints": true
}
```

#### `carroll`

A 2x2 sorting grid: the same idea as a Venn, read off a grid instead of overlapping rings.

Smallest usable: **100mm wide x 76mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "carroll",
  "rowLabel": "has wings",
  "rowNotLabel": "no wings",
  "colLabel": "lays eggs",
  "colNotLabel": "does not lay eggs",
  "shapes": []
}
```

A picture with a dot on each part it names, joined out to a printed label or a blank line for the child to write on. The one helper built around a PHOTOGRAPH.

#### `rainforest-layers`

The rainforest cross-section, labelled by layer.

Smallest usable: **140mm wide x 100mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json

  "helper": "rainforest-layers",
  "labels": true,
```

#### `balanced-pattern-plate`

A neutral proportional food-group plate. The five shares are fixed; you set each group's label, its example foods, and which groups arrive blank for the child.

Smallest usable: **145mm wide x 116mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "balanced-pattern-plate",
  "mode": "practice",
  "givenGroups": [
    "fruit-vegetables",
    "starchy-carbohydrates"
  ],
  "groupLabels": {
    "protein": "Protein foods"
  },
  "examples": {
    "fruit-vegetables": [
      "apple",
      "carrot",
      "peas",
      "berries"
    ]
  },
  "caption": "Aim for this balance across a day or over time, not every meal."
}
```

#### `amazon-study-area-map`

The study area a rainforest unit keeps returning to: South America in outline, Brazil shaded within it, the Amazon basin within that.

Smallest usable: **74mm wide x 110mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
  "labels": true

```

A four-figure grid-reference map, usually the whole point of its sheet. Invent each lesson's numbers, river and features; the example is not a template.

#### `process-chain`

Boxes joined by arrows: a food chain, a life cycle, the order of events. The arrows are the point.

A branching yes/no identification key down to named living things.

```json
      "no": {
        "leaf": "BEE"
      },
      "yes": {
        "leaf": "LADYBIRD"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Shape, space and measure

#### `shape`

A 2D shape with its measurements written on the sides: the picture a child reads to find a perimeter, area or missing length.

Smallest usable: **49mm wide x 21mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "shape",
  "type": "rectangle",
  "aspect": 2.5,
  "labels": {
    "top": "8 cm",
    "right": "3 cm"
  }
}
```

#### `triangle`

A classified triangle: filled body, tick marks, and an optional right-angle square or angle arcs.

Smallest usable: **36mm wide x 36mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "triangle",
  "kind": "isosceles",
  "ticks": true,
  "angleArcs": true
}
```

#### `angle`

A classified angle: two arms and a marking arc or right-angle square. It reads at a glance or not at all.

Smallest usable: **32mm wide x 32mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "angle",
  "degrees": 45,
  "rotation": 0,
  "arc": true
}
```

#### `line-pair`

The parallel, perpendicular or neither pair. Like an angle, it reads at a glance and gains nothing from growing.

Smallest usable: **40mm wide x 19mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "line-pair",
  "relationship": "parallel",
  "arrows": true
}
```

#### `turn-diagram`

Angle as a turn: two rays from a vertex with a curved arrow sweeping between them.

Smallest usable: **111mm wide x 30mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "turn-diagram",
  "turns": [
    {
      "quarters": 1,
      "direction": "clockwise"
    },
    {
      "quarters": 2,
      "direction": "clockwise"
    },
    {
      "quarters": 1,
      "direction": "anticlockwise"
    },
    {
      "quarters": 3,
      "direction": "clockwise"
    }
  ],
  "letters": true
}
```

#### `ruler`

A ruler printed at TRUE SIZE for a child to measure against. It refuses a zone too narrow rather than shrinking, because a scaled ruler makes every answer wrong on a page that looks normal.

Smallest usable: **119mm wide x 18mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "ruler",
  "end": 10,
  "majorInterval": 1,
  "minorInterval": 0.5,
  "unit": "cm",
  "object": {
    "from": 0,
    "to": 6
  }
}
```

#### `clock-row`

A row of analogue clock faces, each with hands set or left blank for the child to draw.

Smallest usable: **106mm wide x 32mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "clock-row",
  "clocks": [
    {
      "time": "3:45",
      "hands": true
    },
    {
      "time": "11:00",
      "hands": true
    },
    {
      "hands": false
    }
  ],
  "letters": true
}
```

#### `coordinate-grid`

A numbered first-quadrant grid a child plots on.

Smallest usable: **110mm wide x 110mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "coordinate-grid",
  "cols": 10,
  "rows": 10,
  "points": [
    {
      "x": 3,
      "y": 4,
      "label": "A"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `reflection-grid`

A dot lattice with a mirror line and a shape to reflect.

Smallest usable: **110mm wide x 110mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "reflection-grid",
  "cols": 10,
  "rows": 10,
  "mirror": "vertical",
  "shape": [
    {
      "x": 2,
      "y": 2
    },
    {
      "x": 4,
      "y": 2
    },
    {
      "x": 4,
      "y": 5
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `translation-shape`

A numbered grid carrying a shape and its slid image, joined by an arrow.

Smallest usable: **110mm wide x 110mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "translation-shape",
  "cols": 10,
  "rows": 10,
  "points": [
    {
      "x": 1,
      "y": 1

    {
      "x": 3,
      "y": 1

    {
      "x": 3,
      "y": 3
    }
  ],
  "translate": {
    "x": 4,
    "y": 2
  },
  "showImage": true
}
```

#### `geoboard`

A dotty-paper peg grid for drawing polygons on.

Smallest usable: **70mm wide x 70mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "geoboard",
  "cols": 5,
  "rows": 5,
  "shapes": []
}
```

#### `triangle-square`

The SATs part-whole puzzle: two triangles joined by lines to a square, the arrow pointing into the square.

Smallest usable: **47mm wide x 40mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "triangle-square",
  "triangles": [
    "55",
    "75"
  ],
  "square": ""
}
```

## Number and calculation

#### `number-line`

A labelled number line carrying marked or blank jumps, boxes to write in, and an object bracket.

Smallest usable: **173mm wide x 12mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "number-line",
  "start": 0,
  "end": 100,
  "interval": 10,
  "labels": "ends",
  "boxes": [
    30,
    70
  ]
}
```

#### `blank-surface`

A draw-your-own surface (a bare number line, empty bar outlines) for a strategy the child constructs rather than fills in.

Smallest usable: **100mm wide x 41mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "blank-surface",
  "surface": "number-line",
  "start": 0,
  "end": 100
}
```

#### `bar-model`

The White Rose bar model: a part-whole bar or a two-bar comparison. Any whole split into named parts fits it.

Smallest usable: **70mm wide x 48mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "bar-model",
  "shape": "part-whole",
  "whole": {
    "label": "24"
  },
  "parts": [
    {
      "label": "8"
    },
    {
      "label": "16"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `part-whole-money`

A whole bubble with parts beneath it, joined by lines.

Smallest usable: **61mm wide x 45mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "part-whole-money",
  "text": "£1.40 + £2.30",
  "whole": {},
  "parts": [
    {
      "label": "£1.40"
    },
    {
      "label": "£2.30"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `column-method-grid`

Ruled boxes for a written column calculation: the numbers stacked, a thick-topped answer row, and a carry row.

Smallest usable: **70mm wide x 49mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json

  "bottom": 1278
}
```

Column multiplication by a single digit, with a thick-topped answer row and a carry row.

Smallest usable: **56mm wide x 57mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

The long multiplication shape: one partial product row per digit of the multiplier, then the total.

#### `bus-stop-grid`

Short division: the answer row on top under the roof, the divisor outside the wall to the left.

The same bus stop with a blank working box beneath, for the child to show the subtract-and-bring-down steps.

## Fractions and money

#### `stacked-fraction`

A fraction written properly, numerator sitting on a rule above the denominator, with a question stem.

Smallest usable: **63mm wide x 20mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "stacked-fraction",
  "text": "Continue the sequence.",
  "fractions": [
    {
      "num": 1,
      "den": 4
    },
    {
      "num": 2,
      "den": 4
    },
    "?",
    {
      "num": 4,
      "den": 4
    }
  ],
  "separator": ","
}
```

#### `fraction-sequence`

The same stacked fractions as a bare row, for use inside a compound question.

Smallest usable: **30mm wide x 13mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "fraction-sequence",
  "fractions": [
    {
      "num": 1,
      "den": 2
    },
    "?"
  ],
  "separator": "="
}
```

#### `fraction-bar`

One or more bars divided into equal parts, some shaded.

Smallest usable: **72mm wide x 30mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "fraction-bar",
  "bars": [
    {
      "numerator": 3,
      "denominator": 4,
      "label": "3/4"
    },
    {
      "numerator": 2,
      "denominator": 5,
      "label": "2/5"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `coin-strip`

A row of coins and notes drawn at their real sizes relative to each other, over a line for the total.

Smallest usable: **79mm wide x 41mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "coin-strip",
  "text": "Sam has these coins. How much money does he have?",
  "coins": [
    "£2",
    "£1",
    "20p",
    "20p",
    "10p"
  ],
  "answerLine": true
}
```

## Comparing and ordering

#### `compare-row`

Two values with an empty box between them, for less-than, greater-than and equals work.

Smallest usable: **52mm wide x 14mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "compare-row",
  "left": "2.3",
  "right": "7.1"
}
```

#### `inequality-with-boxes`

A displayed statement with some digits left as boxes to fill, so the child chooses numbers that make it true.

Smallest usable: **79mm wide x 23mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "inequality-with-boxes",
  "text": "Write digits that make this true.",
  "expression": "5 . □ 2 < 5 . □ 8"
}
```

#### `order-numbers`

Numbers to order on a card, with one blank per number underneath and the separator between them.

Smallest usable: **91mm wide x 29mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "order-numbers",
  "numbers": [
    "0.9",
    "0.34",
    "0.6",
    "0.07"
  ],
  "separator": "<",
  "prompt": "Order from smallest to largest."
}
```

#### `order-table`

The same ordering task laid out as a two-row table: values on top, an empty cell under each.

Smallest usable: **98mm wide x 33mm tall**. Spare height: takes spare height first (it is writing space).

```json
{
  "helper": "order-table",
  "text": "Order these decimals from smallest to largest.",
  "numbers": [
    "0.6",
    "0.06",
    "0.60",
    "0.16"
  ],
  "topLabel": "Numbers",
  "bottomLabel": "Smallest to largest"
}
```

#### `data-table-with-ordering`

A stem, a table of results, a row of blanks to order them into, and room to explain.

Smallest usable: **131mm wide x 35mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "data-table-with-ordering",
  "text": "Four children jumped in PE.",
  "rows": [
    {
      "label": "Child",
      "values": [
        "Kai",
        "Mia",
        "Leo",
        "Ava"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Jump (m)",
      "values": [
        "0.85",
        "0.7",
        "0.68",
        "0.9"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "ordering": {
    "leftLabel": "Shortest",
    "rightLabel": "Longest",
    "blanks": 4,
    "separator": "<"
  }
}
```

## Choosing, sorting and joining

#### `multiple-choice`

A stem, a tick instruction, then each option on its own line beside a tick box.

Smallest usable: **60mm wide x 47mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "multiple-choice",
  "text": "Which of these is a multiple of four?",
  "options": [
    "14",
    "16",
    "18",
    "22"
  ],
  "select": "one"
}
```

#### `circle-the-answer`

A prompt, the options to circle, and room to explain the choice.

Smallest usable: **60mm wide x 20mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "circle-the-answer",
  "prompt": "Circle the larger decimal.",
  "options": [
    "0.48",
    "0.6"
  ]
}
```

#### `chip-bank`

A set of short labels drawn as separate bordered choices, each sized to its own word, so they read as options rather than as running text. A bank titled Word bank prints in vocabulary green unless a variant overrides it.

Smallest usable: **61mm wide x 32mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "chip-bank",
  "text": "Choose a word from the bank.",
  "title": "Word bank",
  "chips": [
    "square",
    "rectangle",
    "rhombus",
    "parallelogram",
    "trapezium"
  ]
}
```

#### `sort-grid`

Named columns with blank rows for a child to sort items into, plus an optional word bank above.

Smallest usable: **80mm wide x 76mm tall**. Spare height: takes spare height first (it is writing space).

```json
{
  "helper": "sort-grid",
  "text": "Sort these into the right column.",
  "columns": [
    "Waterproof",
    "Not waterproof"
  ],
  "rows": 4,
  "wordBank": [
    {
      "word": "foil",
      "imagePath": "photos/foil.jpg"
    },
    "paper",
    "wax",
    "wool"
  ]
}
```

#### `match-up`

Two columns of cards with a dot on each facing edge, for the child to draw the joining line. The columns need not be the same length.

Smallest usable: **80mm wide x 100mm tall**. Spare height: takes spare height readily.

```json
{
  "helper": "match-up",
  "text": "Draw a line from each material to the group it belongs in.",
  "left": [
    {
      "label": "chocolate",
      "symbol": "●"
    },
    {
      "label": "steam"
    },
    {
      "label": "foil"
    },
    {
      "label": "juice"
    },
    {
      "label": "helium"
    }
  ],
  "right": [
    {
      "label": "Solid"
    },
    {
      "label": "Liquid"
    },
    {
      "label": "Gas"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `card-row`

A row of small titled cards, each optionally carrying a picture: plants along the foot of a sheet, artefacts under a timeline.

Smallest usable: **96mm wide x 44mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "card-row",
  "text": "Use an atlas to find where each plant grows.",
  "columns": 3,
  "cards": [
    {
      "title": "Cacao",
      "caption": "Amazon River basin, southern Mexico"
    },
    {
      "title": "Coffee",
      "caption": "Ethiopia, South America, Sudan"
    },
    {
      "title": "Orchids",
      "caption": "Central and South America"
    }
  ],
  "writeLabel": "Because...",
  "markLabel": "Tick if it grows in the rainforest"
}
```

#### `timeline`

A line across the page with named bands along it and dated points beneath, for placing events or artefacts onto.

Smallest usable: **168mm wide x 46mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "timeline",
  "text": "Place each artefact in the correct era.",
  "caption": "The Stone Age",
  "eras": [
    {
      "label": "Palaeolithic",
      "from": 0.02,
      "to": 0.42
    },
    {
      "label": "Mesolithic",
      "from": 0.46,
      "to": 0.72
    },
    {
      "label": "Neolithic",
      "from": 0.76,
      "to": 0.98
    }
  ],
  "marks": [
    {
      "at": 0.02,
      "label": "2,000,000 years ago"
    },
    {
      "at": 0.44,
      "label": "12,000 years ago"
    },
    {
      "at": 0.74,
      "label": "6,000 years ago"
    },
    {
      "at": 0.98,
      "label": "4,000 years ago"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Writing and talk

#### `writing-frame`

Sentence starters with room after each, inside a frame whose SHAPE says what kind of writing this is: a museum tag, a postcard, a plaque.

Smallest usable: **90mm wide x 69mm tall**. Spare height: takes spare height first (it is writing space).

```json
{
  "helper": "writing-frame",
  "shape": "tag",
  "text": "Write a label so your artefact can be displayed in a museum.",
  "starters": [
    {
      "text": "This is a …",
      "lines": 1
    },
    {
      "text": "It is made from …",
      "lines": 1
    },
    {
      "text": "It was used for …",
      "lines": 2
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `storyboard`

Numbered boxes to draw in with writing lines beneath: a journey, a life cycle, a story retold in order.

Smallest usable: **144mm wide x 128mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "storyboard",
  "text": "Draw and write to show the journey of a cocoa bean.",
  "count": 6,
  "columns": 2,
  "lines": 2
}
```

#### `fact-file`

Named slots a child fills in. The field NAMES are what makes it teach: they say what counts as knowing about this thing.

Smallest usable: **55mm wide x 98mm tall**. Spare height: takes spare height first (it is writing space).

```json
{
  "helper": "fact-file",
  "title": "Country fact file",
  "fields": [
    "Name of country",
    "Capital city",
    {
      "name": "Population",
      "hint": "About ... people live there.",
      "wordBank": [
        "thousand",
        "million"
      ]
    },
    "Official language(s)"
  ]
}
```

#### `speech-scene`

Turns of a conversation: a figure, and a bubble either printed to read or empty to fill. An instruction that asks for a tick or a cross is given a box to mark.

Smallest usable: **85mm wide x 70mm tall**. Spare height: takes a normal share of spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "speech-scene",
  "text": "Write a reply that says no firmly and with respect.",
  "turns": [
    {
      "speaker": "Jacob",
      "says": "Can I share this photo of us online?"
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Aisha",
      "side": "right",
      "lines": 3
    }
  ]
}
```

## Cause, effect and evidence

#### `cause-path-grid`

Named steps across the top and a choice to make at each one, so a child traces a cause through to its effect rather than naming both ends.

Smallest usable: **90mm wide x 30mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "cause-path-grid",
  "instruction": "Choose the best cause and effect.",
  "headings": [
    "Cause",
    "Action",
    "Change",
    "Effect"
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "prompt": "Cattle farming spreads into the forest.",
      "choices": [
        "Trees are cleared",
        "Trees are replanted"
      ],
      "symbol": "arrow"
    },
    {
      "prompt": "Heavy rain falls on bare soil.",
      "choices": [
        "Soil washes away",
        "Soil stays put"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `evidence-chain-frame`

A set of possible actions, and for each piece of evidence the ones a child decides should stop now.

Smallest usable: **80mm wide x 30mm tall**. Spare height: never takes spare height.

```json
{
  "helper": "evidence-chain-frame",
  "instruction": "Use the evidence to decide where action should stop.",
  "actions": [
    "Logging",
    "Cattle ranching",
    "Road building"
  ],
  "evidenceRows": [
    {
      "evidence": "Satellite photographs show new roads through the basin.",
      "stopNow": [
        "Road building"
      ]
    },
    {
      "evidence": "The soil is bare and washing into the river.",
      "stopNow": [
        "Cattle ranching"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
